ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (71) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Hugo's ex-priest «Анатолий Лёрэ» (Anatoly Lyore) is given his French name, Anatole Leray. «Воспитание» (vospitanie) is 'upbringing' for the priest's own formation and 'education' for his program of remaking the people; «жесток» (zhestok, 'cruel') of the syllogism is kept apart from «жестки» (zhestki, 'harsh') of the narrator; «болван» (bolvan) is 'blockhead'.
Source observation: [30] «— Нет, вы только что начали, — отвечал я, — По-вашему…»: a comma before the capitalized «По-вашему» where a period is meant; translated as a new sentence.
